## HOW TO USE THIS PLAN

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **LONG** | Buy SPY at market open -- ride with trailing stop |
| **SHORT** | Sell short SPY / sell ES1! at the window open |
| **CASH** | No directional position -- stand flat for the day |
| **FULL (100%)** | High-conviction signal (hist. return >=10%) |
| **HALF (50%)** | Medium-conviction signal (5-10% hist. return) |
| **QUARTER (25%)** | Structural/frequency edge (<5% hist. return) |

> IMPORTANT: Stop Loss Rule -- Set a trailing stop at the listed % from the
> highest close (LONG) or lowest close (SHORT) during the hold period.
> This trails with the market to lock in profit.

> WARNING: CRASH SIGNAL OVERRIDE -- If Finding #4 (Retrograde Pile-Up),
> #5 (Double Vakri), or #13 (Doomsday) fires, EXIT ALL LONGS IMMEDIATELY
> and enter SHORT. These override every bullish signal.

> Signal Hierarchy:
> 1. Crash Signals (#4, #5, #13, #26) -- ABSOLUTE PRIORITY
> 2. Holy Grail Signals (#12, #18, #37 Extremes) -- Maximum Size
